sourceBoundary: The original five owner positions are preserved. The approved expansion makes six collection groups, with 37 distinct original comic identities. The original Out/Brubaker title and writer conflation is retained at position 3 and resolved only by the owner's explicit Include both decision. Born Again's seven-issue story boundary is not expanded by the contents of a different collected edition. Fisk was already mayor before Zdarsky's 2019 run. Neither Zdarsky selection is described as introducing his election. Adaptation and closest-to-the-show claims are not verified selection facts and are not copied into reader-facing descriptions. No third-party narrative, artwork, collection IDs, inferred neighboring issues, full creator runs or additional reading guides are selected.
